prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["How to Play with Your Desktop Pet", "Click to pet, drag to relocate, and right-click for controls and quick menu options.", "Try dragging your pet after finishing!"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize your official adoption!", "Companion Name", "Verified Companion"]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Desktop Match", "Answer a quick question to help us suggest the best companion for your workflow.", "Select your ideal pet vibe"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "We are generating assets and configuring your pet's desktop engine.", "Installing companion assets...", "Tip: Press your shortcut key anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet."]
5: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in to permanently link your pet and preserve its memory across re-installs or new devices.", "Make sure to use your main account so your pet is always saved."]
6: ["Use clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward for best custom pet results.", "Good vs Bad Photo Examples"]
7: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Complete setup now to receive a free Starter Toy bundle for your desktop pet!", "Bonus Unlocked: Starter Toy"]
8: ["You can minimize this window. We'll notify you as soon as your pet appears on your desktop!"]
9: ["Choose Your New Desktop Friend", "Select Species & Style"]
